info.title: DermaScan Backend
info.description: DermaScan backend API for facial skin-condition analysis. Public: POST /auth/login, POST /auth/register, POST /auth/verify-email, POST /auth/resend-verification, POST /auth/google, GET /health. Protected routes require Authorization: Bearer <access_token> (Authorize in Swagger). /users/me reads and updates the caller's profile. POST /ml/predict runs the shipped CNN on 1-3 face photos and returns a GEA grade. POST /history saves a completed scan (photos + interview) and queues LLM recommendations. Items is a placeholder.

post.description:
Log in with email and password.

The 400 / 401 / 403 ``detail`` strings are Indonesian and shown as-is by the app.
The consent check runs before the credential check, so unaccepted terms
return 400 even when the password is wrong. 422 means the body is malformed
and its ``detail`` is a list, not a string.

400.description: Syarat & Ketentuan or Kebijakan Privasi not accepted.

401.description: Wrong email or password, or the account is inactive.

403.description: Credentials OK but email is not verified yet.

post.summary: Create an account (sends email verification code)
post.description:
Create an unverified account and email a 6-digit OTP.

No bearer token is issued here. The app must call ``POST /auth/verify-email``
with the code, which returns the same ``AuthResponse`` shape as login.

400.description: Syarat & Ketentuan or Kebijakan Privasi not accepted.

409.description: The email already has an account.

503.description: SMTP failed to send the verification email.

post.summary: Confirm email with the 6-digit code and log in
post.description: Exchange a valid OTP for a bearer JWT.

400.description: Wrong/expired code, or email already verified.

post.description: Send a new OTP. Unknown emails get a generic success body (no enumeration).

503.description: SMTP failed to send the verification email.

post.summary: Login or register with a Google ID token
post.description:
Exchange a Google ``id_token`` for a DermaScan bearer JWT.

Public endpoint (no Authorization header). Google accounts skip email OTP
(treated as already verified). Consent is checked before token verification.

400.description: Syarat & Ketentuan or Kebijakan Privasi not accepted.

401.description: Invalid Google ID token or inactive account.

patch.summary: Update current user's name and/or email
patch.description:
Update the authenticated user's ``full_name`` and/or ``email``.

Check order: 422 (malformed body / invalid email / empty string) before 401
(invalid token) before 400 (explicit ``null`` or no fields provided) before
409 (email already belongs to another account).

400.description: Empty update payload or explicit null for name/email.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or inactive-user bearer token.

409.description: The requested email is already used by another account.

post.summary: Predict acne severity (GEA 0-4) from 1-3 face photos
post.description:
Run the shipped CNN on the photos and average their probabilities.

Photos are processed in memory and never stored. ``aggregate.grade`` is the
GEA value the app displays; grade 5 cannot be produced because the model only
has classes ``IGA0``-``IGA4``.

400.description: Empty file, undecodable image, or more than three photos.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or inactive-user bearer token.

503.description: Inference runtime or model artifact is unavailable on the server.
